plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, an inked Tetrahymena-to-yeast telomere conservation & TTAGGG repeat chart from Olovnikov (1971, Doklady / 1973 J. Theor. Biol. 41: 181–190), Blackburn & Gall (March 1978, J. Mol. Biol. 120: 33–53), Szostak & Blackburn (May 1982, Cell 29: 245–255), and Moyzis et al. (1988, PNAS 85: 6622–6626) shows Tetrahymena TTGGGG repeats protecting linear plasmids in yeast and human TTAGGG repeats (~10–15 kb at birth) capping all 46 human chromosomes.
